text:
maya: Quick alignment: we have 48h to close launch agreements. Owners: SLA, pricing, docs, monitoring, oncall, rollout. Confirm now.
sam: SLA proposal attached (link). Targets: 99.9% uptime; p95 <120ms; p99 <350ms. fallback policy ok?
devin: fallback to slim-model at 450ms for heavy contexts. Also add SLO-burn alert: named infra.slo_burn_rate_high. I own it.
alex: Pricing: three SKUs (starter/pro/enterprise). Need final numbers for reserved-capacity credits. I'll lock numbers after today's pricing sync.
liz: Docs: will publish quickstart + "troubleshooting latency" by EOD tomorrow. Need sample SDK + curl.
rachel: Oncall: propose dedicated primary+backup for first 72h, then resume regular. I'll prepare the roster.
maya: Rollout: canary 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% over 72h with automated rollback on error-rate >2% or latency SLO breach 15m.
devin: Add chaos-run check to signoff: 5m packet-loss test + cold-start run. Sam can you schedule?
sam: Scheduling chaos run tonight at 23:00 PT. Will post results.
alex: Risk: enterprise sizing unknown. Sales must collect commit windows. Who owns follow-up?
maya: I'll own the ask to Sales; Alex please provide minimum commit guidance.
liz: Customer-facing note: include "expected behavior" section re: cold-starts and quantization artifacts.
rachel: Alerts: retain traces 30d; token-cost dashboard + per-route heatmaps. Also add a paging rule for infra.slo_burn_rate_high -> oncall.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for 1767016399 (T-24h) to collect final signatures.
maya: Final signoff checklist I'll circulate shortly. Please add any outstanding risks here.
sam: One risk: fallback impacts quality regressions. We need a post-rollout eval metric (top-5 prompts).
devin: Agreed. Eng-ML will own regression evals and roll-back thresholds.
maya: Thanks all. Closing owners by T-12h. :thumbsup:
